notes: Timings unprofiled; warmup excluded; order alternates; GC exposed; total includes init and disposal.
Ablation only removes direct destination lstat in an isolated compiled copy; never applied to source.
Profile samples cover full process including imports, verification hashes, GC and cleanup.
multi-markup.cpuprofile used a shared filename; use multi-profiles unique thread profiles for worker analysis.
profileCommands:
source artifacts/wse-perf-fix-20261001/env.sh
set -e
ROOT=artifacts/wse-checkpoint-profile-20261001
WSE_BENCH_SAMPLES=11 node --expose-gc scripts/benchmark-crawl.mjs "$ROOT/defaults.mjs" "$ROOT/no-destination-check/lib/index.js" > "$ROOT/ablation.json" 2> "$ROOT/ablation.log"
for workload in buffered streamed local markup; do
 WSE_BENCH_SAMPLES=9 WSE_BENCH_MODES=SingleThreadDownloader WSE_BENCH_WORKLOADS=$workload node --expose-gc --cpu-prof --cpu-prof-dir="$ROOT" --cpu-prof-name="single-$workload.cpuprofile" scripts/benchmark-crawl.mjs "$ROOT/defaults.mjs" > "$ROOT/profile-single-$workload.json" 2> "$ROOT/profile-single-$workload.log"
done
WSE_BENCH_SAMPLES=5 WSE_BENCH_MODES=MultiThreadDownloader WSE_BENCH_WORKLOADS=markup node --expose-gc --cpu-prof --cpu-prof-dir="$ROOT" --cpu-prof-name=multi-markup.cpuprofile scripts/benchmark-crawl.mjs "$ROOT/defaults.mjs" > "$ROOT/profile-multi-markup.json" 2> "$ROOT/profile-multi-markup.log"
node --expose-gc scripts/benchmark-queue.mjs artifacts/wse-010-implementation/runtime-audit/baseline-091/node_modules/p-queue/dist/index.js artifacts/wse-010-implementation/final-validation/source/node_modules/p-queue/dist/index.js > "$ROOT/queue.json"
node --expose-gc scripts/benchmark-options.mjs artifacts/wse-010-implementation/runtime-audit/baseline-091/node_modules/got/dist/source/core/options.js > "$ROOT/options.json"
python3 "$ROOT/summarize-profiles.py"
